_comment: Reprint of the invoice from checkout-cash-sale.json, requested by a different user than the original cashier. Demonstrates InvoiceReprintResult (remediation pass 2): the wrapped `invoice` is byte-for-byte the same InvoiceDetail that GET /invoices/{invoiceId} would return, unaffected by how many times it has been reprinted; only the wrapper fields describe this one reprint occurrence.
_note: A second reprint of the same invoice (e.g. 2026-09-20T15:30:00+08:00) would return the identical `invoice` block with a new reprint_event_id/reprinted_at/requested_by -- confirming reprint occurrence state never mutates the underlying Invoice (Stage 2 invariant #11).
